player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between the Sunroom and Utility room, repeatedly traversing the same edges without tracking visited rooms or unvisited neighbors. I also stopped prematurely at the Wine cellar without verifying if all rooms (specifically the Guest room and Closet) had been visited. Next time, I will maintain a mental set of visited rooms. Upon entering a new room, I will immediately check all available directions; if any lead to an unvisited room, I will prioritize that direction over returning to the previous room. I will only output "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the total number of unique rooms encountered, ensuring no room is skipped.
